introduction: I delve into one of the last relics of the Facepunch era.

vocabulary.definition: an object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest
vocabulary.example: The museum displayed a relic from the ancient civilization.

vocabulary.definition: pertaining to or capable of phagocytosis, the ingestion of particles by a cell or phagocyte
vocabulary.example: The phagocytic cells in the immune system help to engulf and destroy harmful bacteria.

vocabulary.definition: a hardened rock formation created by the solidification of lava from a volcanic eruption
vocabulary.example: The hikers marveled at the intricate lava cast formations along the trail.

vocabulary.definition: to bring back to life or consciousness; restore
vocabulary.example: The community worked together to revive the abandoned park into a thriving green space.

vocabulary.definition: an abnormal fear of being in enclosed or narrow spaces
vocabulary.example: His claustrophobia made it challenging for him to ride in elevators.

vocabulary.definition: an event or situation serving as a warning or reminder to address a problem or issue
vocabulary.example: The sudden drop in profits was a wake-up call for the company to reassess its business strategy.
